what_for: Lowers blood pressure, so your heart works less hard.
how_to_take: One pill each evening, with a meal or right after eating. Take it at the same time each day. Don't stop taking it suddenly.
side_effects: Feeling tired or dizzy, mostly at first. Cold hands or feet.
call_doctor_if: You feel faint, your heartbeat feels very slow, you are very short of breath, or your ankles swell.
